page.notes: The first word "collabascat" carries a cedilla-like mark over the c in the scan; read as printed. The bottom left margin note is cut at the edge of the scan and only its first letters are visible. The reference marks in the text (r, f, t, u) match the margin notes. Scan shows stains and faint marks in the left margin; not transcribed. The marginal note's first word is cut at the top of the scan and was read as "u" with [?]. The catchword "atque" sits right-aligned under the last full line, above the ruled rule.
